name: grok-browser-relay
description: Relay between the Grok Browser extension and your own Grok Bot webhook routine (Cloudflare Worker + SQLite Durable Object).

EXT_TOKEN.description: A long random string the extension sends. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` or the **Generate tokens** button in Grok Browser's settings, and keep it: you paste it into the extension.

REPLY_TOKEN.description: A *different* long random string. Your Grok Bot uses it to post answers and fetch screenshots. Give it to your bot when it asks (secure secret request).

GROKBOT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: The **POST to** URL of the `Grok Browser` webhook routine your Grok Bot created.
